components: a short tick at the top
a body curving down and left
a short mark at the lower left
a short mark at the lower right
strokeOrder: draw the short tick at the top, sloping down to the right
lift; begin below the tick and curve down, round to the right and away down to the lower left
lift; draw the short mark at the lower left, sloping down and to the left
lift; draw the short mark at the lower right, sloping down and to the right
strokeOrderNote: Sirgazil's 31-frame animation moves the start marker three times, which is three pen lifts and four strokes; the two bottom marks are drawn left first, then right.

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sirgazil, Hiragana ふ stroke order animation.gif, hiragana ふ, 31 frames, 3.1 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 1 October 2009)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The CC0 animation draws ふ as four separate strokes in the order tick, body, lower-left mark, lower-right mark. KanjiVG's data for U+3075 holds four paths in the same order. Handwriting joins the body to one or both of the bottom marks in fast cursive; the four-stroke order taught here is the printed and taught one.

notes: The fu of ふたつ, two things. The first sign in this book that takes four strokes, and the two bottom marks are separate from each other and from the body.
